name: Weaver
ability: You start knowing a set of players with something in common. Each day, you may privately guess what it is.
firstNightReminder: Show the Weaver a set of players with something in common.

name: Stableboy
ability: Each night, you learn 1 in-play character.

name: Genius
ability: Each night, choose a good character: you have that ability until you choose again. You are drunk every other night.
firstNightReminder: The Genius chooses a good character.
otherNightReminder: The Genius chooses a good character (or acts as that ability if they are not drunk).

name: Poet
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn how many of a particular letter is in their character name. (But not which letter.)
otherNightReminder: The Poet chooses a player. Show the number of a particular letter in that player's character name.

name: Astrologer
ability: Each day, visit the Storyteller to learn 1 piece of false information.

name: Coachman
ability: Each day, 1-word topic on which the Storyteller gives a fact. If your neighbors are different alignments, it is false.

name: Nun
ability: Good Townsfolk can not be drunk, poisoned, or get false information.

name: Dilettante
ability: You think you are an Townsfolk and you have that ability.  Good players who nominate you are drunk until the following dusk.

name: Prisoner
ability: You may not vote. You know 1 not-in-play character. If most players choose to free you, become that character & alignment.

name: Amaniti
ability: Your neighbors register falsely to good players' abilities.

name: Scarecrow
ability: To good players, you register as the Demon & the Demon registers as a Minion.

name: Daughter of Nox
ability: Good's info is reversed. The 1st time each player names you: lose your ability (if they are good) or regain it (if they are evil).

name: Virilus
ability: Each night, choose a player to infect. Infected who nominate, die & infect the nominee. After day 4, evil wins.
otherNightReminder: The Virilus chooses a player to infect.

name: The Rising
ability: Most players start dead, vote normally & are resurrected if executed.  The 1st living executee, loses.  After day 4, evil wins.
